title: Persistent Educational Memory Layer
description: Implement a conversational memory layer enabling the tutor to remember context across tutoring sessions and turns. Includes session lifecycle tracking, Socratic dialogue state persistence, educational summarization, semantic retrieval over past sessions, and memory injection into the LangGraph TutorNode.

userStories.title: Session Lifecycle
userStories.description: As a student, I want the tutor to remember the current tutoring conversation across turns so that I don't have to repeat myself.
acceptanceCriteria: Session state created on first user message
Session updated after each tutor turn
userStories.notes: New memory_sessions table. SessionManager in src/core/memory/session_manager.py. Session lifecycle: start -> heartbeat -> close. Auto-close via last_active_at check.

userStories.title: Socratic Continuity
userStories.description: As a student, I want guided Socratic dialogue to resume where it left off so that reasoning flows continue naturally across interruptions.
userStories.notes: New memory_socratic_states table. SocraticManager in src/core/memory/socratic_manager.py. LLM writes stage + next_question; code persists. 4 stages: guided_discovery, evaluation, correction, consolidation.

userStories.title: Session Summarization
userStories.description: As a student, I want tutoring sessions summarized automatically so that long-term educational continuity is preserved efficiently.
userStories.notes: New memory_educational_summaries table. Summarizer in src/core/memory/summarizer.py. ChromaDB collection 'educational_memories'. Triggered by session close. LLM extracts understanding_level, key_misconceptions, confidence, next_learning_goal. Embedding stored via Embedder (reuses existing RAG embedder).

userStories.title: Semantic Memory Retrieval
userStories.description: As a student, I want the tutor to recall relevant past educational discussions so that responses remain personalized.
acceptanceCriteria: Semantic retrieval from educational_memories ChromaDB collection operational
Ranking considers recency, confidence, and topic relevance
Token budget enforced (1500 tokens max for memory context)
userStories.notes: RetrievalOrchestrator in src/core/memory/retrieval_orchestrator.py. Custom ranking layer combining cosine similarity (0.3) + recency weight (0.4) + confidence weight (0.3). Token budget enforcement (1500t) via truncation by rank with 14-day recency half-life. Topic filtering via ChromaDB $and where.

userStories.title: Memory Injection into Tutoring
userStories.description: As a student, I want the tutor to use my learning history when explaining concepts so that tutoring adapts to my needs.
acceptanceCriteria: System prompt prefix injected with learner context (mastery, misconceptions, Socratic stage, recent summaries)
Active misconceptions visible in tutor behavior
Backward compatible (no memory = current behavior preserved)
userStories.notes: ContextAssembler in src/core/memory/context_assembler.py. Reads SessionState + SocraticState + top-N summaries (via RetrievalOrchestrator) + StudentMastery + MisconceptionPattern data. Formats as 1500t system prompt prefix with per-section budgets. Injected via AgentState.memory_context. TutorNode falls back to bare Socratic if no assembled context. Backward compatible. Socratic state saved back to DB after each tutor turn. Session heartbeat + tutor_interaction event logged.

userStories.title: Educational Events Logging
userStories.description: As a developer, I want memory lifecycle events logged so that I can debug and analyze memory behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Key events logged: session_started, session_closed, misconception_detected, socratic_breakthrough
Metadata captures relevant context per event
userStories.notes: New memory_events table. EventLogger in src/core/memory/event_logger.py. Lightweight async logging. Not a full event bus - deferred.
